item.title: Shreveport man sentenced to 10 years for pointing handgun at police drone
item.description: A Shreveport man who pleaded guilty earlier this year to pointing an illegal handgun at a police drone has been sentenced to 10 years in prison. Eutravious Houston, 33, entered a guilty plea Feb. 26 before Donald E. Hathaway Jr., judge of the First Judicial District Court. item.title: Caddo Parish prosecutors seek death penalty in killing of Vivian police officer
item.description: Prosecutors with the Caddo Parish District Attorney’s Office have announced they will seek the death penalty against the man accused of killing a police officer in Vivian late last year. item.title: Burn ban lifted in Caddo Parish
item.description: The burn ban in Caddo Parish has been lifted, according to Caddo Fire District 4. Fire officials announced the change and reminded residents to continue practicing safe burning habits. Residents are encouraged to never leave fires unattended and to keep water nearby in case conditions change. item.title: Bossier Parish burn ban lifted following recent rainfall
item.description: The burn ban in Bossier Parish has been lifted following recent rainfall, according to the Bossier Parish Police Jury.
